archetypes.name: race-window-audit
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the cd+pwd-P ancestor re-resolution actually closes the TOCTOU window rather than introducing a new inter-step race, and whether the containment case pattern handles all symlink-escape shapes correctly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether `design_publish_ancestor_within_root`'s `cd "$(dirname "$_file")" && pwd -P` re-resolution occurs close enough to the downstream `cp` staging call to prevent a post-resolve-pre-copy race, and whether an attacker can insert a directory swap between the `cd` and `pwd -P` steps themselves. Verify that the three loop placements (plan-review, render-cache, .completed) fire the guard immediately before the staging call rather than at an earlier, non-adjacent point in the loop body where a window would still exist. Check whether the containment `case "$_parent" in "$_root"|"$_root"/*` pattern correctly rejects a symlink that resolves to a sibling path (e.g. `/tmp/root-sibling` when root is `/tmp/root`), and confirm that when `dirname` of a file directly under the subtree root returns the root itself the guard does not false-positive reject. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sanitize-contract-fidelity
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the per-line sanitize_diagnostic_line wrapping at each HIGH/MEDIUM relay site is consistent with the lib-quiet.sh:81-88 per-line contract and whether every loop structure actually delivers one line at a time to the wrapper.
archetypes.prompt_body: At each proposed relay change (ship-pr.sh ~894-901, collect-findings.sh ~217-243, collect-agent-results.sh ~311, review-core.sh ~531-534), verify that the enclosing loop already iterates strictly one line at a time — if any loop reads multi-line chunks or uses command-substitution that strips trailing newlines before reaching `sanitize_diagnostic_line`, the plan's per-line wrapping premise is violated and embedded newlines would be silently dropped. Check that `sanitize_diagnostic_line` is layered on top of (not replacing) the existing `redact-secrets.sh` pass at each site, and confirm no site already applies a conflicting sanitization step that would cause double-stripping or silent truncation. Verify the plan's claim that piping an empty string through `sanitize_diagnostic_line` yields an empty string so that `larch_err ""` blank-line behavior is preserved across all relay sites. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
